title: User login
description: As a user, I want to sign in with a username and password so that I can access the lessons.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen is shown, when I enter a username and a password of at least 4 characters, then the Sign in button becomes enabled.
When I tap Sign in with valid credentials, then I am taken past the login screen (no error shown).
When I enter the username 'locked' with any 4+ character password and tap Sign in, then an error message is shown on screen.
When the username or password field is empty, then the Sign in button remains disabled.
